cmsFields.title: GTA6-KytyPS5-GTA-6 review: emulator source missing
cmsFields.subtitle: A four-file source tree, an unverified emulator claim, and release notes that describe console streaming.
cmsFields.summary: A pinned-source teardown finds no emulator implementation in GTA6-KytyPS5-GTA-6; release notes describe PS5 streaming. Playability and safety are unverified.
keyTakeaways: The pinned tree contains four files and no emulator source, build system, or tracked GitHub Actions workflow.
The README describes local emulation; the inspected v1.0.0 release notes describe streaming from a real PS5.
A committed build-success statement and an available ZIP do not establish a reproducible emulator.
No binary or gameplay test was performed; compatibility and download safety remain unverified.
